steps.text: Build the board as the starting map shows
steps.note: Experienced players can use the variable set-up instead

steps.text: Each player: 5 settlements, 4 cities, 15 roads and a building costs card
Place your 2 starting settlements and 2 roads on the board as the starting map shows
steps.note: 3 players: nobody plays the red position

steps.text: Longest Road and Largest Army cards and the 2 dice beside the board
Resource cards in 5 faceup stacks; development cards shuffled facedown
Take 1 resource for each terrain hex around your settlement marked with a white star; keep your hand hidden
Distance Rule: a settlement needs all adjacent intersections empty
